findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_published_intelligence_catalog" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Free, read-only catalog of structured intelligence products published by connected workers, including paid-eligible counts, prices, sample paths and x402 purcha…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "create_checkout" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_fulfillment_proof, get_live_inventory, get_published_intelligence_catalog, get_published_intelligence_sample, get_free_data_sample, create_checkout, get_paidhandshake_capabilities · Private data: get_published_intelligence_sample, get_free_data_sample, create_checkout, get_machine_payment_options, get_machine_onboarding, submit_paid_machine_job, get_machine_wallet · Public sink: submit_paid_machine_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_fulfillment_proof, get_live_inventory, get_published_intelligence_catalog, get_published_intelligence_sample, get_free_data_sample, create_checkout, get_paidhandshake_capabilities · Private data: get_published_intelligence_sample, get_free_data_sample, create_checkout, get_machine_payment_options, get_machine_onboarding, submit_paid_machine_job, get_machine_wallet · Public sink: submit_paid_machine_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
